logger.doc:name: Log POST Orders Request
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, message: "POST orders request received.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map (item) -> { orderId: item.orderId, customerName: item.customerName, customerEmail: item.customerEmail, productName: item.productName, quantity: item.quantity, orderAmount: item.orderAmount, currency: item.currency, orderStatus: item.orderStatus, sourceSystem: item.sourceSystem, orderCreatedAt: item.orderCreatedAt, ingestionStatus: "INGESTED", syncStatus: "PENDING", fileName: item.fileName }

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Insert Orders Into Database
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO ordersStaging ( orderId, customerName, customerEmail, productName, quantity, orderAmount, currency, orderStatus, sourceSystem, orderCreatedAt, ingestionStatus, syncStatus, fileName ) VALUES ( :orderId, :customerName, :customerEmail, :productName, :quantity, :orderAmount, :currency, :orderStatus, :sourceSystem, :orderCreatedAt, :ingestionStatus, :syncStatus, :fileName )

logger.doc:name: Duplicate Order
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, errorType: "DUPLICATE_ORDER", errorMessage: error.description, correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]

set-payload.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { success: false, message: "Order already exists.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]
set-payload.doc:name: Duplicate Response Payload

logger.doc:name: Duplicate Order Response
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, message: "Duplicate order response sent.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { success: true, message: "Orders inserted successfully.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }

logger.doc:name: Post Orders Response
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, message: "POST orders response sent successfully.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]
